purpose: What the shipped app asks of FFmpeg. The build checks the bundled FFmpeg against this list (packaged_runtime.py ffmpeg-check) and stops when a required entry is missing; an optional one (NVIDIA only, AV1 recordings) is only reported. Audio Mangler.ps1 is not shipped and is not counted.

encoders.name: libx264
encoders.why: the proxy, clips, review videos and every AI Video Editor render; the fallback whenever NVENC fails

encoders.name: aac
encoders.why: the sound of the proxy, clips, review videos and editor renders

encoders.name: libmp3lame
encoders.why: Full Review's audio.mp3 and the evidence audio snippets

encoders.name: pcm_s16le
encoders.why: the 16 kHz WAV every transcription starts from, and the raw sound piped to the levels

encoders.name: pcm_f32le
encoders.why: the editor's scene and joined sound before the one AAC encode

encoders.name: flac
encoders.why: Find my bug reports' narration FLAC

encoders.name: mjpeg
encoders.why: every .jpg still, contact sheet and thumbnail

encoders.name: rawvideo
encoders.why: the game-picture sampler's gray keyframes and gray tiles

encoders.name: h264_nvenc
encoders.why: NVIDIA PCs only; every use falls back to libx264

decoders.name: h264
decoders.why: H.264 recordings and the editor's own scenes

decoders.name: flac
decoders.why: the narration FLAC read by Whisper

decoders.name: mjpeg
decoders.why: stills read back for contact sheets and tiles

filters.name: drawtext
filters.why: editor titles, still time stamps and contact-sheet labels

filters.name: scale_cuda
filters.why: NVIDIA PCs only; the next attempt uses scale

demuxers.name: mp3
demuxers.why: only when Whisper reads an MP3

devices.name: lavfi
devices.why: the NVENC test source and the privacy mask canvas
